title: Hello, I'm looking for VX or VX Ace styled battlers

posts.author: avelanch
posts.body:
I'm first to this community and also not an English native. I apologize in advance ;((
I'm developing a game using RPG Maker VX Ace. My game's battler has both VX and VXAce styles, so any battlers with this style are welcome.
I'm looking for a level 1 basic goblin battler for a tutorial. It will emerge in the grasslands, and it will have a basic sword/leather armor.
Also, I'm looking for a level 5 totem pole battler. The wooden totem pole with an owl and an animal spiritual carved on it. It shouldn't look so big and tall, as it's just a structure that aids other enemies, like tribemen.
Please help me get these materials or find a website with these ones. Correct me if there are any mistakes, or give me any recommendations. Thank you

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
